title: Te Hoa i Tahuri ke
intro: Kei te tata koe ki te hura i te kōrero mō tētahi wairua i noho i raro i te atarangi o te poropititanga, engari i whiriwhiri i te ara e arahi ana ki te whakangaromanga. I noho tahi tēnei tangata me tētahi o ngā karere whiriwhiri a Allah, engari i rahua i te whakamātautau whakapono. Ko wai tēnei hoa ngaro?
clues: I noho ahau i roto i te hunga i whakakahore i te karanga ki te tika, ā, kāore ahau i whakahē i a rātou.
I moe ahau i tētahi poropiti a Allah, engari kāore au i whakaae ki taua whakapono.
I te taenga mai o ngā karere ki tōku kāinga me te whakatūpato, kāore ahau i whakapono ki a rātou.
I whakahaua taku hoa rangatira kia wehe atu i te tāone me te hunga whakapono, ā, kāore ahau i roto i a rātou.
I tau te whiu ki runga i tōku iwi, ā, i whakangaromia tahitia ahau me rātou.
Kua whakahuatia ahau i roto i te Quran hei tauira o te kore whakapono, i te taha o te wahine a Noa, i roto i te Surah At-Tahrim.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Te wahine a te Poropiti a Noa
Te wahine a te Poropiti a Ruta
Te wahine a te Poropiti a Ihāperahama
Te wahine a te Poropiti a Mohi
Te wahine a te Poropiti a Ayyub
identity.answer: Te wahine a te Poropiti a Ruta

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: I tinihanga i tana tāne mā te kore whakapono
I whakakahoretia te karere a te Poropiti a Huta
I karakiatia ngā whakapakoko i roto i te Kaaba
I whakatakoto mahere mō te kaupapa a tana tāne
I whakakahore ki te whakaae ki te poropititanga a tana tama
trial.answer: I tinihanga i tana tāne mā te kore whakapono

arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verse: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter." (66:10)
